name: Metal charm on red
note: Worn silver charm on a black-to-red gradient, square. Send the plain Voxl render: the metal holds the cube layout well. It casts neighbouring cubes as one piece. (The 09:55 run that proved it was sent this prompt as a list of character codes, by a lab server bug since fixed.)
prompt:
{
  "task": "Transform the attached image into a stylized 3D metal charm, preserving its original silhouette and key graphic details.",
  "preserve": { "original_silhouette": true, "key_graphic_details": true },
  "material": {
    "type": "thick silver metal",
    "color": "strictly monochrome neutral silver-gray",
    "color_behavior": "fully monochrome, no colored tint, no red coloration, no warm color contamination",
    "edges": "beveled",
    "surface_details": ["subtle wear", "scratches", "brushed texture", "dark oxidized areas", "faint smoky haze softly diffused across parts of the metal surface"],
    "internal_details": "thin dark engraving"
  },
  "rendering": {
    "object_position": "floating",
    "camera_angle": "slight 3/4 angle",
    "depth": "visible thickness and dimensional depth",
    "reflections": "realistic monochrome metallic reflections without picking up red color from the background",
    "lighting": "strong studio lighting"
  },
  "background": {
    "type": "smooth vertical linear gradient",
    "direction": "top-to-bottom (pure black at top -> vivid red at bottom)",
    "color_stops": ["#000000 0%", "#1A0000 3%", "#320001 10%", "#CC0001 50%", "#FF2E1D 100%"],
    "constraints": ["perfectly smooth blend", "strictly vertical", "bright, clean, vivid", "no haze/smoke/texture/noise/glow/banding on the background"]
  },
  "composition": { "format": "square", "placement": "centered", "object_isolation": true, "style": "premium editorial product render" },
  "negative_prompt": ["no metal attachment ring or hanging loop protruding from the object", "no smoke around the object"]
}
